## Question

State the question or hypothesis and link the relevant report or source.

## Existing evidence

Identify the revision/checkpoint, cases, metric, and limitations that matter.
Separate a recorded observation from your interpretation.

## Proposed next step

If proposing an experiment, describe the changed factor, matched controls,
case/seed policy, budget, and result that would answer the question. State what
data or local artifacts would be required. Leave this section out for a question
that only needs clarification.
